title: Implement per-bit MI and GMI estimators
description:
Implement information-metric estimators that can evaluate the reliability of individual bit-channels from modem outputs or collected LLR statistics.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] The analysis tooling can estimate per-bit mutual information or GMI for supported modem paths.
- [ ] The estimators are compatible with the demapper semantics selected for analysis.
- [ ] Results are suitable for comparing the relative quality of different bit positions within a symbol.

## Notes

This task builds on the per-bit LLR statistics tooling and should remain compatible with the shared modem source of truth.
